fields.options:
I understand the R250 participation fee must be paid via EFT and that my spot is only confirmed once proof of payment is received via WhatsApp.
I will be present on the night (7 June 2026). I understand that no-show means automatic disqualification, regardless of whether my tracks were selected.
My tracks are AI-assisted or fully AI-produced. They contain no copyrighted samples without clearance. I take full responsibility for the content.
I understand the track submission deadline is 3 days before the event. Late submissions will not be accepted under any circumstances.
I agree to receive event updates and communications from Prompt Party via WhatsApp and email.
